summary: SEH exception filter. Dereferences a1 (EXCEPTION_POINTERS) to its exception record and tests the C++ exception signature: record code equal to 0xE06D7363, parameter[0] equal to 3, parameter[1] equal to 0x19930520. On a full match it dispatches to SEHWrapperDispatchingToHandlerFunction with a1. Otherwise, when the global handler pointer lpfn is non-null and passes CodePointerValidation, it invokes lpfn() and returns its result. Returns 0 when neither path runs.

operations.description: Load the exception record pointer from *a1, the EXCEPTION_POINTERS.ExceptionRecord field.
Guard: exception record code field (v1[0], offset 0x0) equals 0xE06D7363, the C++ exception code.
Guard: exception record parameter[0] (v1[4], offset 0x10) equals 3.
Guard: exception record parameter[1] (v1[5], offset 0x14) equals 0x19930520.
When all three signature guards pass, dispatch to SEHWrapperDispatchingToHandlerFunction with a1 (named in raw source; no separate callee evidence ref exists for it).
Fallback guard: the global handler pointer lpfn is non-null and CodePointerValidation(lpfn) succeeds.
CodePointerValidation validates that lpfn is a valid code address before it is called.
Indirect call of the validated global handler lpfn with no arguments; its result becomes the function result.
Return 0 when neither the SEH signature match nor a valid global-handler path is taken.
